maria_cs: Heads-up — I kicked off a dry-run of the sparse-field reconciler for CRM tonight. target set: populate missing onboarding_stage for ~8k accounts (mostly EMEA). running in read-only mode first. please confirm no overlapping playbook jobs tonight.

sam_engineer: Nice. Which playbooks could conflict? the auto-nudge and onboarding-timer ones?

anya_data: Yep, auto-nudge and lifecycle-timer both write to onboarding_stage. My quick overlap scan: ~420 accounts are in the queue for auto-nudge in next 24h. I can exclude them with a where clause.

leo_ops: I can block the scheduled playbook window 23:30-00:30 UTC if that helps. Want me to toggle safemode for that hour? :lock:

maria_cs: Yes please block 23:30-00:30 UTC. we'll run the reconciler at 23:45 as read-only then flip to a write-dryrun that logs intended changes. no writes without ack.

ryan_csm: For context — what logic are we using to infer onboarding_stage? any chance of changing onboarding owner or account state? we should avoid touching owner fields.

anya_data: Ruleset summary: 
- infer onboarding_stage from last_event_type + product_usage_bucket + days_since_first_session
- only set stage if confidence >= 0.88
- never touch owner_id or account_tier
(we'll surface the proposed changes in a csv for CSM review)

sam_engineer: Putting the SQL snippet here for the exclusion we talked about:
```sql
-- exclude accounts with pending auto-nudge or timers
WITH excluded AS (SELECT account_id FROM playbook_queue WHERE playbook_name IN ('auto-nudge','onboarding-timer') AND scheduled_at BETWEEN now() AND now() + interval '24 hours')
SELECT * FROM accounts WHERE onboarding_stage IS NULL AND account_id NOT IN (SELECT account_id FROM excluded) LIMIT 10000;
```

playbook-bot: dry-run job created: reconciler-sparse-2026-03-23T23:45Z (id: pb-rc-9812). logs will be posted to #eng-ops.

leo_ops: Blocked the playbook window. added emergency rollback contact: @sam_engineer, @anya_data.

maria_cs: I'll coordinate a quick CSM sample review at 00:05 UTC to look at ~200 sampled accounts (diversity across ARR and region). @ryan_csm can you assemble 6 CSMs for 10-min review?

ryan_csm: I can get @tal, @jess, @omar, @lucy, @pri to spot-check. we'll flag any edge cases and return a pass/fail.

anya_data: Export command for the sample CSV (will anonymize PII):
```bash
python tools/export_reconciler_sample.py --job pb-rc-9812 --sample-size 200 --anonymize true --out s3://redwood-reconciler-dryruns/2026-03-23/sample-9812.csv
```

sam_engineer: Quick perf note — reconciler uses a rolling batch of 250 accounts per worker. if we see >1.2s avg inference for rule evals we should throttle concurrency. I'll be watching.

maria_cs: Final checklist before run:
- [x] ops window blocked (leo_ops)
- [x] exclude playbook queue (sam_engineer)
- [x] ruleset and confidence threshold reviewed (anya_data)
- [x] CSM sample reviewers lined up (ryan_csm)
- [ ] post-run CSV uploaded + CSM sign-off (action)

playbook-bot: note: this job will annotate intended_changes with metadata: {source: 'sparse-reconciler', confidence}. No owner overwrites permitted.

leo_ops: I'll leave a pager for 00:00-01:00 UTC in case of any unexpected writes.

ryan_csm: We'll aim to sign off by 00:25 UTC. If anything looks off we veto write execution.

maria_cs: Thanks all — initiating read-only run at 23:45. I'll post a one-line summary and the sample link here after the job finishes. :rocket:
